name: sprint19_taker_imbalance_reversion_altcoins
hypothesis: Extreme short-window taker buy/sell volume imbalance predicts short-horizon reversion in altcoin returns (crowded aggressive taker flow gets absorbed by resting liquidity), net of costs at the tightest fee tier and a short hold.
power_argument: Prior three sprints (n~5800 each) imply per-trade return stdev ~60bps (back-solved from t-stats). At n=300, 80% power, two-sided 5%, min detectable edge ~= 2.8*60/sqrt(300) ~= 10bps net. Setting entry_per_day_cap to yield >=300 trades over the standard sprint test window satisfies this.
symbols: altcoin_basket_v1 (same universe as sprint16-18, per registry)
